questions.stem: Which of the following best describes an ecosystem?

options.text: A single food chain in a habitat
The non-living components of an environment
All the living organisms and their physical environment interacting together in an area
A group of organisms of the same species living in the same area

questions.explanation: An ecosystem is a community of living organisms (biotic factors) interacting with each other and with their non-living physical environment (abiotic factors). It includes all the organisms, their relationships, and the physical conditions in a particular area.
